digest.component_or_area: Pydantic Agent run accounting and failure semantics
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate usage (sum of all attempts) exactly once in memory, telemetry, and one durable JSONL row without per-attempt rows or rejected-attempt subtraction

On validation-failure exhaustion, the original Rebar StructuredOutputError object must be re-raised by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; on repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion with no Rebar object in the chain, a fresh UnretryableOutputError must be constructed as the defined fallback
Terminal failure artifacts must capture the complete final provider response only when artifact policy enables it, without mutating earlier retry-wire messages
Failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens without inventing usage values for calls that reported none
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions (lacking 'Exceeded maximum output retries' marker) must pass through unchanged

No new competing request-budget fields (e.g. candidate_requests) must be introduced to usage or JSONL schema, maintaining historical byte-compatibility except for approved higher counters after successful retry
